_how: Every feature on the /features page, by part of the app. scene picks the app component drawn beside the list. Rebuild with python tools/build_site.py.

groups.name: Windows app
groups.intro: SocialShot runs on your own PC, free, with your own AI key.
items: Free Windows app
The whole clipping engine on your own PC, for Windows 10 and 11. Every feature, no subscription.
Setup that checks your PC
Sign in, it checks your computer and installs what is missing, then sits in the tray while it works.
Bring your own AI key
OpenAI, Gemini, Claude, Grok, Groq, OpenRouter, or Ollama on your own machine. You pay your provider only for what you use.
Works without a key
No key yet? Clips are still picked from the loudest and busiest moments of the stream.
Sign in once from the app
A one-time code links the Windows app to your account in your browser, Google sign-in included.

groups.name: Getting videos in
groups.intro: Links, files, live streams and creators that record themselves.
items: Paste a link
A YouTube, Twitch or Kick link is all it takes to start.
Upload big files
Drop in a recording from your computer. Large files go up in pieces, so a dropped connection does not start over.
Record live streams
Clips while the stream is still running, or tap to clip the best moment right now.
Creators that record themselves
Add a creator once: recording starts when they go live, clips when someone says a word you pick, and a limit on clips per hour.
Members-only streams
Add your browser cookies and streams you can watch can be recorded too.

groups.name: Finding the moments
groups.intro: Every moment scored from what was said, the voice and the chat.
items: Scored from words, voice and chat
Every moment is scored from what was said, how loud it got and how fast chat moved, and each clip shows why it was picked.
More clips on request
Liked the first batch? Ask for more from the same video.
Hooks, titles and hashtags
Each clip gets a hook on screen, a title, a description and hashtags, written from what was said.

groups.name: Clips
groups.intro: Vertical clips with the speaker in frame, captioned word by word.
items: Four shapes
9:16 for Shorts, Reels and TikTok, plus 4:5, 1:1 and 16:9.
Nine layouts
Split with the face cam below, picture in picture, trio, face grid, pop-out, centre crop, zoomed in, full frame and post card.
Face cam found for you
The streamer's camera is found automatically and kept in frame.
38 caption styles
Word-by-word captions in looks like Editorial, Karaoke, Bounce, Hype, Neon, Glass box and Podcast.
14 fonts
Poppins, Mazzard, Anton, Bebas Neue, Montserrat, Bangers and more for captions and hooks.
Hindi and Urdu in Roman letters
Hinglish captions written the way people actually type them.
Re-listen
Words came out wrong? Re-listen to a clip and get fresh captions.

groups.name: Editor
groups.intro: Fix, trim and polish a clip without leaving the browser tab.
items: One-click AI editor
Plans music, zooms and sound effects for the whole clip in one go.
Fix captions word by word
Edit any line, and click a word to jump straight to it in the clip.
Trim and clean up
Multi-shot trimming, and filler words and long pauses removed for you.
Zooms, looks, intro and outro
Zoom into the big moments, pick a colour look, add an intro and an outro.
Music and sound effects
Built-in music and sound effects, with the voice level kept clear.
Made for speed
Undo and redo, safe zones for each app, templates and keyboard shortcuts.

groups.name: Your brand
groups.intro: Your logo, colours, fonts and handles on every clip.
items: Brand kit
Your logo, saved caption styles and a watermark with your social handles.
Your music and media
Keep your own music, pictures and outros in one library.

groups.name: Posting
groups.intro: Post now or line clips up, with rules you set once.
items: YouTube, Instagram and TikTok
Connect each account once and post from SocialShot.
Auto-post with your rules
Post only clips above a score, with a gap between posts and a daily limit.
Schedule
A calendar and a board of scheduled, posted and failed clips. Drag to plan, in any time zone.
Download one or all
Download a single clip, or every clip from a video in one ZIP.

groups.name: Account
groups.intro: Alerts where you already are, and the costs in plain view.
items: Alerts on Discord and Telegram
Get told when clips are ready, with a test button to check it works.
See what AI costs
An AI usage page shows the tokens behind every video.
Your account, your way
Google sign-in, email check, password reset, light or dark look, and deleting your account any time.
